content: Fleming Cottage Hospital is a healthcare facility located in Aberlour, Morayshire, Scotland, and operates under the UK National Health Service (NHS). It is managed by the NHS Grampian region. The hospital was specifically designed for its purpose and is physically connected to the local health centre, which provides general practitioner (GP) services, community nursing, and other primary care services. The hospital has a total of 15 beds and offers a range of services, including medical care, rehabilitation, patient assessment, palliative and terminal care, convalescence, and respite care. Additionally, the facility includes a minor injuries and casualty department to address less severe medical emergencies. Outpatient clinics for general medical and surgical care are also conducted on-site. Fleming Cottage Hospital was officially opened in April 1900. Its construction was funded by a legacy left by James Fleming (1830–1895), a distiller. The building was designed by the architect James Leslie Findlay.
